entities.name: Sylvok
entities.description: Reclusive human ethnic group of the Tangle on Mirrodin, practicing a druidic religion; extinct after Melira died.

entities.name: Tangle
entities.description: Region of Mirrodin where the Sylvok lived.

entities.name: Araneas Altar
entities.description: Eight-sided shrine the Sylvok built around the Lacunae to honor Lord Araneas.

entities.name: Lord Araneas
entities.description: Figure honored at the Araneas Altar.

entities.name: Vanishing
entities.description: Event in which half the Sylvok population disappeared.

entities.name: Benzir
entities.description: Young druid who became de facto leader and began animal worship after a vision quest.

entities.name: Kessla
entities.description: Notable Sylvok of Temple Might who probably survived without corruption.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: Sylvok Outcast; the last Sylvok, whose death made them extinct.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: Arrival of which destroyed or compleated most Sylvok.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion after which the Sylvok became extinct.

events.summary: Half the Sylvok disappeared in the Vanishing, and Benzir became de facto leader.
events.quote: Half the Sylvok population disappeared in the Vanishing

events.summary: Benzir's vision quest led to animal worship among the Sylvok.
events.quote: This has led to a culture of animal worship among the Sylvok

events.summary: New Phyrexia's arrival destroyed or compleated most Sylvok.
events.quote: The vast majority were either destroyed or compleated

events.summary: The Sylvok became extinct when Melira died.
events.quote: the Sylvok became extinct when Melira died
